title: Phase 2：規則 54 在寬度除以 4 餘 1 的環上，暫態 w−3，週期 4（R2-C10 最後一段，相位牆）

R2-C10.proof: All four residue classes now have a Lean proof without an upper bound on w: w ≡ 0 (DISC-0010, rule54_mod4_zero, w ≥ 4), w ≡ 2, 3 (DISC-0011, rule54_mod4_two/three, w ≥ 6 / 7), w ≡ 1 (this record, rule54_mod4_one, w ≥ 9; general argument for w ≥ 17, w = 9, 13 from the finite check of DISC-0006). Numeric check by two implementations with cell-by-cell cone and phase-wall check for w ≤ 1200.

novelty.note: No new searches in this record. Ether, phase-shifted ether domains and the walls between them are standard rule-54 particle language (Hanson–Crutchfield 1997 etc., not re-read). Folding is the technique of DISC-0009/0011. The reused OEIS query is the mixed four-class sequence and does not discriminate the w ≡ 1 class (4k + 2). Not checked: arXiv, MathSciNet, Jen's cylindrical CA papers, Wolfram's finite-ring tables. PROVEN_KNOWN means proven with known techniques, not claimed new.
